items.name: The Lucky Horseshoe
items.blurb: Every smith's first true masterwork. Hang it points-up over the forge door to keep the luck in, or so the old farriers swear.

items.name: The Founder's Bell
items.blurb: Cast in bell bronze, four parts copper to one of tin. Strike it once and the whole valley knows the forge is lit.

items.name: The Ember Dagger
items.blurb: A short blade of bright steel, its edge quenched until it sang. Small enough for a boot, sharp enough for a legend.

items.name: The Nightwatch Lantern
items.blurb: Pierced iron around a steady flame. It has lit many a smith home long after the coals went grey.

items.name: The Vigil Helm
items.blurb: Raised from a single sheet of steel with a thousand patient blows. The visor lifts, so the wearer can see whom to thank.

items.name: The Bulwark Shield
items.blurb: A steel face on a riveted frame, banded and bordered. Built to take the blows so its bearer doesn't have to.

items.name: The Twin Moon Axe
items.blurb: Two crescent blades on one haft, balanced so well it feels lighter than it is. It is not light.

items.name: The Gilded Crown
items.blurb: Gold beaten fine and set with stones that drink the forge-light. Kings may wear it, but every king knows which smith made him shine.

items.name: The Starfall Longsword
items.blurb: A long, true blade with a fuller from hilt to point. Its steel is said to hold a little iron that fell from the sky.

items.name: The Star-Taker Astrolabe
items.blurb: Brass plates, a turning star map and a sighting rule. Hold it to the night sky and it tells the hour by the stars.

items.name: The Thunderhead Warhammer
items.blurb: A spiked head on an iron-banded haft, heavy enough to dent plate. Every apprentice asks to hold it once, and only once.

items.name: The Anvil of Ages
items.blurb: The last and greatest Masterwork: an anvil to forge all others. It rings like a bell, and every word you have forged echoes in it.
